parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: IsWhite
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-black-white-list --resource-type GATEWAY --type IP --gateway-unique-id gw-32d5c9769c1842b1a2cc3426c59e0000 --is-white true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
